## Research focus

The manuscript examines online learning for international students in U.S. higher education, with attention to acceptance, participation, and cultural responsiveness. I am a co-author with Y. Duan, E. Romero-Hall, and J. A. Morrow.

## Manuscript citation

Duan, Y., Romero-Hall, E., Wang, W., & Morrow, J. A. (under review, 2026). Is online learning really ready for international students? Acceptance, participation, and cultural responsiveness in U.S. higher education. *Education Sciences*.
